contract.purpose: Make the episodes-spent to shipping-changes ratio visible while a line of work is still running.
contract.shipping_candidate: A named concrete change to agent/agent.py that alters DEFAULT behaviour, with a paired measurement behind it. A new script, a default-off knob, a ledger entry, an instrument repair or a negative result does not count.
contract.on_warning: Not an instruction to stop. State explicitly why the line still deserves episodes; a hard negative can be worth a hundred.
contract.counter: Episodes are recorded by the runners; candidates are added by hand. A line that keeps measuring degrades its own ratio unattended.

board-value-instrumentation.note: stride, interleave, item cap, saturation, safe capacity, kappa siblings, option damage, stream variants, branch labels, diff harness, fixed-work knob

board-receptivity.note: Tetris terms A/R/H as a top-K selection rule; opened 2026-08-02 after the official score log

retracted_candidates.change: LOOKAHEAD_SELECTION_MODE default weighted -> board (agent/agent.py), keeping LOOKAHEAD_TOP_K at the shipped 3
retracted_candidates.evidence: Paired against a simultaneously-run base arm on the five development configs: +6/+3/+4/-5/+4 placed, 4W/1L, suite total 84 -> 96. Sign test p=0.375 at n=5, so promising and not established; a second paired block is running. The b001-k20 loss is real and unexplained.
retracted_candidates.retraction_reason: Did not replicate. A second paired block (base r1 / board_k3 r2, same five configs) gives +4 where block 1 gave +12, and b000-k15's +6 reverses to -1 because the board arm itself swings 23 -> 16 on that config. Pooled 10 pairs: 6W/3L/1T, sign test p=0.508. Per config the effect IS reproducible and mixed: +4/+5 on b000-k40 and +4/+4 on b001-k30, against -5/-4 on b001-k20. Net about +4 on a base of 85, inside the suite noise band.

shipping_candidates.evidence: Two paired blocks, 30 episodes, five development configs: placed 9W/0L/1T vs base, sign test p=0.0039, suite totals 143 -> 179. Four of five configs return identical values in both blocks. Attempts per step and policy time unchanged, so the work is redistributed rather than increased. reports/first-pass-depth, docs/FIRST_PASS_DEPTH.md.
